notes.title: Shattered Worlds fixes
notes.content:
Shattered Worlds received a new, minor update that fixed inconsistencies throughout the game. Tile passability issues, minor graphical changes, stage name labels and tile inconsistencies were some of the things that were patched.

[h2]What exactly changed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Filly Cave has been renamed to [b]Filly Cavern[/b] to remain consistent throughout the game.
[*] Quest Log has been updated with the new Filly Cavern term.
[*] Two NPC dialogs in Dothe Center have been fixed.
[*] Tharsala Catacombs 3 name label was fixed to show the correct number.
[*] Lore mention in the Seacoast House was fixed.
[*] Some tile passability issues have been addressed. The problematic tiles were in Chaac's Temple, Mara's Home and in Sahuagins' Settlement tower.
[*] Minor tile changes in Prometheus' and Persephone's rooms.
[/list]

Thanks to user [b]Euphoniac[/b] for their detailed bug report in the forums!

If your game doesn't update by itself, please go to Shattered Worlds in your Library, then select Properties, navigate to "Local Files" and choose "Verify Integrity of Game Files..." to initiate the update.
